categories.main_business_segments: LG H&H operates primarily in three segments: Beauty (cosmetics), HDB (Home Care & Daily Beauty products), and Refreshment (beverages). The Beauty segment includes luxury and premium cosmetic brands such as The History of Whoo, Su:m37, O Hui, and CNP. The HDB segment covers personal care and household products like shampoo, toothpaste, and detergents. The Refreshment segment focuses on carbonated and non-carbonated beverages, including Coca-Cola and Monster Energy.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced biotechnology, fermentation, and herbal ingredient technologies in cosmetics, alongside proprietary formulation and packaging innovations such as pump toothpaste and eco-friendly containers. Production involves large-scale manufacturing facilities in Korea and overseas, utilizing continuous and batch processes with a focus on quality control and sustainability. R&D centers in Korea, the US, China, and Japan support product innovation and technology development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: LG H&H serves a broad customer base including department stores, duty-free shops, discount stores, supermarkets, convenience stores, and direct sales channels. Its products target both domestic Korean consumers and international markets, especially in China, Southeast Asia, Japan, North America, and Europe. The company also serves B2B customers through raw material sales in the home care segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in South Korea and has significant overseas operations in China, Japan, the United States, Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand), and Europe. It maintains manufacturing plants and sales subsidiaries in these regions, with a strong presence in Asian luxury and premium cosmetic markets and expanding footprint in North America and global duty-free channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: LG H&H operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing, branding, marketing, and distribution of finished consumer products. It sources raw materials globally but controls production and distribution through its own facilities and subsidiaries, including bottling operations for beverages and contract manufacturing for cosmetics and home care products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in bio-fermentation, herbal and natural ingredients, and eco-friendly packaging to enhance product differentiation and sustainability. R&D efforts focus on advanced skin science, microbiome research, and clean beauty trends. Strategic initiatives include expanding digital sales channels, strengthening premium and luxury brand portfolios, and investing in carbon neutrality and ESG practices.
categories.revenue_model: LG H&H generates revenue primarily through product sales of cosmetics, personal care, household goods, and beverages via multiple channels including retail, duty-free, direct sales, and e-commerce. It also earns licensing and royalty income from brand partnerships and engages in B2B raw material sales. Revenue is recognized mainly from domestic and international sales of finished goods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: LG H&H is a leading player in the Korean cosmetics and consumer goods market, holding strong market shares in luxury cosmetics, home care products, and beverages. It competes with domestic firms like Amorepacific and global multinational companies in cosmetics and FMCG sectors. Its competitive advantages include a diversified brand portfolio, extensive distribution network, and strong R&D capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, LG H&H reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 6.8 trillion with a 5.3% decline from the previous year, and operating profit of KRW 487 billion, down 31.5%. The company has a total asset base of around KRW 7.2 trillion and equity of KRW 5.5 trillion. Despite recent revenue and profit decreases due to global economic slowdown and cost pressures, LG H&H maintains a robust financial position with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: LG H&H emphasizes differentiated luxury and premium brands with unique herbal and fermentation-based formulations, backed by scientific research and innovation. It offers high-quality, eco-friendly products with strong brand loyalty and extensive distribution coverage. The company’s value proposition includes combining traditional Korean beauty heritage with modern technology, sustainability commitments, and a comprehensive lifestyle product portfolio to meet evolving consumer needs.
